meta.title: AnonReq
meta.description: Watch a prompt get anonymized, sent to xAI Grok, and restored.

footer.note: Provider keys stay on the server. Token mappings are not stored in this browser.

playground.title: Three views of one request
playground.lede: The raw prompt, the masked text the model should see, and the answer after AnonReq puts the real values back.
playground.modelHelp: Sent as the model field. The gateway resolves the alias, then calls xAI.
playground.pinnedTenantHelp: Pinned on the server as ANONREQ_TENANT_ID. This page cannot change it.
playground.localeHelp: Sent as X-AnonReq-Locale. Separate from this page’s language.
playground.shortcut: Ctrl or ⌘ and Enter to run
playground.rawHint: What you sent. Spans are marked when the preview endpoint answers.
playground.anonHint: What leaves the network: [TYPE_N] tokens instead of personal data.
playground.modelRawHint: Actual response from Grok over the wire — still using [TYPE_N] tokens before AnonReq restores them.
playground.answerHint: The model reply after AnonReq restores reversible tokens.
playground.empty: Run a prompt to fill these columns.
playground.previewDisabledTitle: Anonymized prompt is not in the API response
playground.previewDisabledBody: POST /v1/chat/completions returns the restored answer and the X-AnonReq-* headers. It does not return the masked prompt. This column fills when POST /v1/debug/anonymize-preview is enabled (ANONREQ_DEBUG_PREVIEW_ENABLED=true and an admin credential). A 404 means that flag is off. The preview does not call the model.
playground.rateLimited: This admin has hit the preview rate limit. Wait a moment, then run the prompt again.
playground.separateCalls: Preview and completion are separate calls, each with its own request id.
playground.network: The demo UI could not reach its own server route.
playground.spansMissing: Entity marks appear when the preview endpoint is available.
playground.scenariosHint: Pick a regulated industry case or upload your own file below
playground.downloadSample: Download sample file to test upload:
playground.uploadDrop: Drop a document here or click to browse
playground.uploadSub: Extracts text locally on the demo server and checks whether it is safe to send to AI.
playground.taskLabel: Optional AI Task / Instruction (when sending to Grok)
playground.verdictHeading: AI Gate Verdict — Is This File / Prompt OK?
playground.verdictCleanTitle: OK to Send — No Regulated Identifiers Detected
playground.verdictCleanBody: 0 personal identifiers or credentials were found. Classification is PUBLIC.
playground.verdictGovernedTitle: Not OK in Cleartext → SAFE via AnonReq Gateway
playground.verdictGovernedBody: Direct upload to ChatGPT/Grok would expose {count} regulated spans ({classification}). AnonReq replaces every identifier with a reversible token before outbound transit.
playground.verdictSecretBody: Found {secretCount} non-reversible credential(s) (API_KEY) alongside {total} total spans. AnonReq masks secrets permanently (never restored in the model reply) while restoring authorized PII.
playground.verdictFailClosedTitle: Fail-Closed Active — 0 Bytes Forwarded to Upstream LLM
playground.verdictFailClosedBody: Detection sidecar is unreachable or rejected the locale. AnonReq blocked the request rather than risking a cleartext leak.
